title: シ vs ツ
tips: シ (shi) strokes point downward/vertically. ツ (tsu) strokes point sideways/horizontally.

highlights.left: Stroke order starts from top to bottom, angles point up-right.
highlights.right: Stroke order starts from left to right, angles point down-right.

title: ソ vs ン
tips: ソ (so) starts with a top stroke going down-right. ン (n) starts with a left stroke going up-right.

title: ク vs ケ
tips: ク (ku) is closed on the left and has two strokes. ケ (ke) has a vertical stroke crossing the top stroke.

title: チ vs テ
tips: チ (chi) has a slanted top stroke crossing the horizontal. テ (te) has two parallel horizontal strokes.

highlights.left: Slanted top stroke crosses the horizontal line.
highlights.right: Two clean horizontal lines with no intersection.

title: サ vs セ
tips: サ (sa) has a horizontal line crossed by two vertical-ish strokes. セ (se) has a hook on the right.

title: ヌ vs ス
tips: ヌ (nu) has a crossing diagonal stroke forming an 'X' on the right. ス (su) has no extra cross stroke.

highlights.left: An extra cross stroke forming an X shape.

title: ワ vs フ
tips: ワ (wa) has a vertical left side stroke. フ (fu) has no left side stroke.

highlights.right: Begins directly with the top-right bend.
